BackendInterval.description: Closed interval on the backend clock. ``end >= start``.
BackendInterval.title: BackendInterval

ClientHello.description:
First message on every WebSocket. Browser -> backend. Owner: P5.

``sessionToken`` comes from POST /api/v0/handshake and is bound to ``clientInstanceId``.

clientInstanceId.description: Random per page load; a reload is a new client.
clientInstanceId.title: Clientinstanceid

ClientHello.title: ClientHello

ClockCorrection.description: How device time was converted to backend time (P1 applies it; P5 provides mappers).
ClockCorrection.title: ClockCorrection

ClockPing.description: Backend -> browser. The browser must answer immediately with ClockPong. Owner: P5.
ClockPing.title: ClockPing

ClockPong.description: Browser -> backend. Echoes the ping and adds browser receive/send times. Owner: P5.
ClockPong.title: ClockPong

ClockStatus.description:
Backend -> browser (diagnostics). Estimate of browser-minus-backend offset. Owner: P5.

browserMs = backendMs + offsetBrowserMinusBackendMs (+/- uncertaintyMs).
ClockStatus.title: ClockStatus

DetectorInfo.description: Identity of the experimental detector (P3's model bundle).
DetectorInfo.title: DetectorInfo

EegDeviceInfo.description: Device metadata as reported by P1's adapter. Unconfirmed values stay null.

confirmed.description: True only once P1 has verified this against the device.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

EegDeviceInfo.title: EegDeviceInfo

EegFeature.description: One feature value. ``value`` null requires ``missingReason``; a valid zero is a real zero.
EegFeature.title: EegFeature

EegFeatureWindow.description:
P1 -> backend hub -> P3. One complete, continuous window of features.

``evidence`` is the acquisition interval converted to backend time. ``deviceEvidence`` keeps the
original device timestamps. ``tProcessedBackendMs`` is when features became available.
EegFeatureWindow.title: EegFeatureWindow

EegStatus.description: P1 -> backend hub. Stream-level status, sent on change and at least every 5 s.
EegStatus.title: EegStatus

EegWindowQuality.description: Quality checks reduce contamination; they do not prove remaining activity is neural.
EegWindowQuality.title: EegWindowQuality

ErrorReport.description: Either direction. Never contains signal values. Owner: P5.
ErrorReport.title: ErrorReport

GazeCalibration.description:
Browser -> backend, on every calibration state change. Owner: P2.

Accuracy is measured on held-out points excluded from fitting.

heldOutErrorNorm.description: Mean held-out error as a fraction of video width.
heldOutErrorNorm.title: Heldouterrornorm

GazeCalibration.title: GazeCalibration

GazeObservation.description:
One processed webcam frame. ``tBrowserFrameMs`` is when the frame was captured/observed.

``measurementKind`` must say ``head_direction`` if the model does not estimate screen gaze.
``insideVideo`` false is a valid observation ("looking outside video"), distinct from invalid.

modelConfidence.description: Model-specific; not comparable with other models or with EEG scores.
modelConfidence.title: Modelconfidence

GazeObservation.title: GazeObservation

GazeObservationBatch.description: Browser -> backend, at most ~10 batches/s. Owner: P2.
GazeObservationBatch.title: GazeObservationBatch

Heartbeat.description: Liveness. Either direction. ``clock`` names the sender's clock. Owner: P5.
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat

ManualBookmark.description: Browser -> backend: the viewer pressed 'mark'. Owner: P4.
ManualBookmark.title: ManualBookmark

MediaInterval.description: Closed interval in media seconds. ``end >= start``.
MediaInterval.title: MediaInterval

ModePolicy.description:
Which operating modes may produce automatic suggestions.

A mode is ``automatic`` only if the detector bundle declares it evaluated (or the run is
simulated). Otherwise automatic suggestions are disabled in that mode.
ModePolicy.title: ModePolicy

NormalisedPoint.description:
Point in the displayed video content rectangle. (0,0)=top-left, (1,1)=bottom-right.

Values outside [0,1] are allowed and mean the estimate is outside the video.
NormalisedPoint.title: NormalisedPoint

PlaybackEligibility.description:
Backend -> inference (P3) and browser (diagnostics). Owner: P5.

When ``eligible`` becomes false or ``segmentId`` changes, the detector must clear pending
decisions and wait for a complete evidence window starting at or after ``eligibleSinceBackendMs``.
This does NOT mean EEG filters should be reset (P1 keeps filter state continuous).
``epoch`` increases by one on every change.
PlaybackEligibility.title: PlaybackEligibility

PlaybackState.description:
Browser -> backend. Sent on every media event and every ~1 s while playing. Owner: P4 (P5 contract).

``segmentId`` is non-null exactly when ``state == "playing"``. A new segment id starts whenever
frames start advancing after any interruption (pause, seek, buffering, rate change, source change).
Within one segment ``playbackRate`` is constant. ``tBrowserMs`` is when the media element event
was observed, not when the message was sent.

telemetrySeq.description: Monotonic per video within a page load.
telemetrySeq.title: Telemetryseq

PlaybackState.title: PlaybackState

Provenance.description: Who produced a message and in what kind of run.
Provenance.title: Provenance

backendInstanceId.description: Backend instance the browser last talked to.
backendInstanceId.title: Backendinstanceid

lastReceivedSeq.description: Highest server seq the browser processed.
lastReceivedSeq.title: Lastreceivedseq

ReviewBookmark.description:
Backend -> browser. A candidate mapped to media time by P5, or a manual bookmark. Owner: P5.

``suggestedMediaS`` is a conservative restart suggestion derived from the evidence interval,
not a measured lapse onset. ``bookmarkId`` is stable per event, so clients can de-duplicate.
ReviewBookmark.title: ReviewBookmark

ReviewCandidate.description:
P3 detector -> P5 hub. Backend clock only: the detector never needs media time.

``evidence`` is the interval the decision is based on. ``decisionBackendMs`` is when it was made.
``eventId`` must be stable: re-sending the same event must reuse it (duplicates are dropped).
``eligibilityEpoch`` is the latest PlaybackEligibility.epoch the detector saw (diagnostic only).
ReviewCandidate.title: ReviewCandidate

SensorStatus.description: Backend -> browser and inference. Sent on change. Owner: P5.
SensorStatus.title: SensorStatus

ServerHello.description:
Reply to ClientHello. Backend -> browser. Owner: P5.

``backend_restarted`` means every backend-clock timestamp and segment the browser knew is void:
start a new session. ``resumed`` is followed by a SessionSnapshot.
ServerHello.title: ServerHello

SessionConfig.description: Backend -> browser: authoritative session configuration. Owner: P5.
SessionConfig.title: SessionConfig

SessionSnapshot.description: Backend -> browser after a successful resume. Replaces any client-side session state.
SessionSnapshot.title: SessionSnapshot

SessionStart.description:
Browser -> backend: start a session for one video. Owner: P5 (sent by P4's player).

One session = one video. To change video, send SessionEnd then a new SessionStart.
SessionStart.title: SessionStart

SignalScore.description: A named score from one signal. Scores from different sources are not interchangeable.
SignalScore.title: SignalScore

TranscriptContext.description: Filled by the browser (P4) from its transcript; the backend always sends null.
TranscriptContext.title: TranscriptContext

UserFeedback.description: Browser -> backend. Owner: P4. Logged for evaluation (P3).
UserFeedback.title: UserFeedback
